# Pretendard 1.3.9

The variable font in `android/app/src/main/res/font/pretendard_variable.ttf` is Pretendard Variable 1.3.9 by Kil Hyungseok (orioncactus). The family name is `Pretendard Variable`. Weights used by the UI are 400, 500, 600, 650, and 700 on the `wght` axis.

The license is the SIL Open Font License 1.1, in `LICENSE.txt`. The font is not modified.
